items.episode_title: Jason La Canfora: Baltimore Ravens 2026 Season PREVIEW
items.summary: La Canfora analyzes the firing of John Harbaugh and the swift promotion of Jesse Minter, noting that the team needed a fresh energy and voice but still wanted to protect their defensive blueprint.
items.speaker: Jason La Canfora
items.quote: It really felt like the end of Andy Reid, like in Philadelphia.

items.episode_title: Jason La Canfora: Baltimore Ravens 2026 Season PREVIEW
items.summary: Doyle is a highly debated hire due to his complete lack of play-calling experience. Doyle chose Baltimore over other options due to the leverage of working with Lamar Jackson and installing a collaborative playbook.
items.speaker: Jason La Canfora
items.quote: So I just think Declan Doyle had a chance to work with Lamar Jackson... but I also think there's going to be a learning curve.

items.episode_title: Jason La Canfora: Baltimore Ravens 2026 Season PREVIEW
items.summary: The public and media's consistent adoration for GM Eric DeCosta's drafts has inflated Baltimore's futures markets, making their +1000 Super Bowl odds an undesirable value proposition.
items.speaker: Jason La Canfora
items.quote: It seems inflated to me, Ross, it has all along.

items.episode_title: Jason La Canfora: Baltimore Ravens 2026 Season PREVIEW
items.summary: Despite two MVP campaigns, Jackson remains highly scrutinized by both media and local fans. His contract, previous trade demands, and postseason shortcomings continue to cloud his long-term reliability.
items.speaker: Jason La Canfora
items.quote: He's been polarizing from the get-up... the goalpost always moves for him.

items.episode_title: Jason La Canfora: Baltimore Ravens 2026 Season PREVIEW
items.summary: Nnamdi Madubuike underwent major neck surgery in April. If he is limited or cannot handle his normal heavy snap share, the defensive unit's floor falls dramatically.
items.speaker: Jason La Canfora
items.quote: We're talking about a career-saving, career-extending neck surgery for a guy who's used to playing 760 snaps a year.

items.episode_title: Jason La Canfora: Baltimore Ravens 2026 Season PREVIEW
items.topic: Quinnen Williams contract extension with Cowboys
items.summary: Ross highlights the unusual nature of Dallas extending Quinnen Williams for 3 years, $106M with over $100M guaranteed when he had substantial time remaining on his prior contract.
items.speaker: Ross Tucker
items.quote: That's not really the Cowboys' style... giving a guy a massive 3-year extension.
